decisions.reason: As a prominently promoted new-generation core printer platform that fits the firm's main marking business, it likely showed enough promise to justify continued commitment.
This software module supports digital variable-data printing and serialization, and its low carrying cost makes it a sensible option to keep open.
The coder for non-absorbent surfaces matches important customer applications and uses the firm's ink and system expertise, though as a hardware niche it carries somewhat more review risk.
As a successor app for code decoding, it extends the firm's traceability offering at low cost, so the firm is likely to retain it while market potential continues to unfold.

Inline code verification is strategically relevant for compliance and end-to-end traceability, but if uptake proved limited its higher support burden makes it the most plausible candidate for pruning.
Homepage visibility and strong complementarity with the installed printer base make this design software a low-cost, strategically attractive product to continue offering.
